items.title: Cloud backup

faq.a: Nahi â€” Rokar fully offline chalta hai. Billing, inventory aur reports sab local computer par save hote hain. Internet sirf optional cheezon ke liye hai, jaise WhatsApp receipt ya cloud backup.
